Seal Fate.note: Resource loop: builder crits → extra combo points → finishers sooner. Crit (Malice, Lethality) drives it; Relentless Strikes and Ruthlessness feed off the finishers.

Relentless Strikes.note: Resource loop: 5-point finishers almost always refund Energy, which buys the next builder.

Ruthlessness.note: Resource loop: finishers can start the next cycle with a free combo point.

Hack and Slash.note: Axe/Sword: extra attacks. Dagger/Fist: crit bonus (feeds Seal Fate).

Setup.note: Resource loop: dodges and resists add combo points (pairs with Lightning Reflexes).

Initiative.note: Openers from Stealth start with an extra combo point.

Remorseless Attacks.note: After a kill, the next builder has much higher crit (and so Seal Fate).

Improved Poisons.note: More poison applications; Venom and Malice make poisons hit harder.

Vigor.note: Larger Energy pool: more room to pool for burst and Relentless Strikes refunds.

Venom.note: Combo: Shank → stronger and more frequent poisons for 6 sec.

Death Mark.note: Burst: stores part of your damage (double for Garrote and Rupture) and releases it after 6 sec.
